_comment: velocity m/s, gravity = projectile gravity scale. Optional: acceleration (m/s^2, negative = slows down) + acceleration_time (s, the game's ConstantAccelerationTimeout: the motor acts in the 20 ms flight substeps that start before it), max_speed (m/s, the projectile's MaxSpeed: the speed is capped at every substep, the first one too; omitted or 0 = no cap), lifespan (s, the projectile's InitialLifeSpan: the round is destroyed that long after launch, so a shot that takes longer is refused; omitted = the game sets none, the mortar's shell), rotation_follows_velocity (default true: the motor pushes along the path; false: along the barrel's axis at launch, the UB-32's S-5), arc low/high, aim overlay/elevation, unit deg/mil, angle_offset, min_distance, elevation_limits [min,max], bore (deg: how far above the screen centre the shot leaves in the view the weapon is aimed through; the game fires along the barrel socket Attach_Muzzle, tilted against the camera), zoom (FOV divisor of that view: a scope, an optic or the gunner's sight; omitted = ×1; a weapon whose RMB sight zooms the screen has two entries: '<base> · optic (RMB ×N)' for the sight and '<base> · no optic' for its normal view, with that camera's bore and no zoom), view ('optic' on the RMB sight, 'plain' on its normal-view twin; the app shows it next to the weapon) + twin (on an optic entry: the name of its plain twin), launch_height + muzzle_forward + muzzle_up (m: the barrel pivot above the ground and the barrel socket along and above the barrel), hold_rate + hold_elevation (a barrel laid by holding a key), category, warhead (direct/splash, launchers, guns and tanks: splash when the round's damaging explosion reaches beyond 10 m in the game files, tools/game_weapons.py burst_radius; the marker note judges a splash round by the ground like a grenade), note. Sources: velocity, gravity, rocket motor, speed cap, lifespan, view and the elevation limits of the direct-fire mounts read from the game files (Squad build 26005357: WeaponConfig.MuzzleVelocity; the projectile's ProjectileGravityScale, ConstantAcceleration/Timeout, MaxSpeed, bRotationFollowsVelocity and InitialLifeSpan; the mount's pitch limits plus the barrel socket's pitch; snapshot tests/data/game_weapons.json, written by tools/game_weapons.py); the other elevation limits, arcs and the AGS-17 hold model from in-game measurements, the official Squad wiki (squad.fandom.com) and SquadCalc (github.com/sh4rkman/SquadCalc).

Mortar (M252 / 2B14 / L16 / Type 63).note: Set the mils on the mortar sight. Range 51–1236 m. Auto-lay: W raises the barrel to its top (1580 mil), S lowers it at 9°/s (game files: keyboard pitch ×300 per second × turret input ×0.03, the same at any frame rate, sensitivity or zoom; the AGS-17's ×15 × 0.6 is also 9°/s, and its 67 measurements fit 9°/s as well as their fitted 9.08°/s).

Technical Mortar.note: Angle is the value on the technical's elevation readout: the HUD table (40° = 1250 m ... 83.8° = 50 m) lays the barrel about 5° above it. The shell starts 1.61 m along the tube, 1.18 m above the ground at its hinge.

M1064 M121 (120mm).note: Barrel laid between 50° and 85° (turret pitch 0–35° on a 50° tube); the shell starts 3.46 m along the tube, which pivots 0.82 m above the ground.

Hell Cannon.note: Set degrees on the elevation scale; the shell is slow — expect a long flight.

UB-32 (S-5 rockets).note: Rockets slow down during the first 2 s; fire in salvos and correct by the impacts.

Technical UB-32.note: Pod laid between 0° and 50°. Rockets slow down during the first 2 s; fire in salvos and correct by the impacts.

BM-21 Grad.note: Launcher laid between 14.2° and 55° (pitch 0–40.8° on a 14.2° rail): nothing closer than about 985 m on flat ground. The rockets start 2.73 m along the rail, 1.77 m above the ground at its hinge.
